name: Inner Mongolia Shuangxin Environmental Protection Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Inner Mongolia Shuangxin Environmental Protection Materials Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of polyvinyl alcohol products in China and internationally. It offers polyvinyl alcohol fiber, methyl acetate, acetaldehyde, vinyl acetate, and calcium carbide. The company exports its products to approximately 40 countries and regions in Europe, South America, and Southeast Asia.
